name: Yousef al-Shelash

summary.text: Yousef al-Shelash is the chairman and co-founder of Dar Al Arkan, described as Saudi Arabia's largest real-estate developer, whose international arm Dar Global partners with the Trump Organization on Trump-branded projects in Oman, Dubai, Jeddah and Doha. Donald Trump's financial disclosures show licensing income from Dar Al Arkan of about $21.9 million for 2024, including fees for Dubai and Oman projects, and Forbes estimates al-Shelash's fortune at about $900 million, largely in Dar Al Arkan shares.

facts.claim: Al-Shelash is Dar Al Arkan's chairman and co-founder; Dar Global, the company's international arm, builds and markets the Trump-branded towers to which the Trump Organization lends its name.

facts.claim: Plans for Trump Tower Jeddah, Dar Global's debut in the city and its second collaboration with the Trump Organization after Trump International Oman, were reported on 1 July 2024; Enterprise described a 47-floor, 350-unit tower valued at SAR 2 billion with completion scheduled for December 2029.
facts.quote: The Jeddah tower is their second collaboration following the recent announcement of the Trump International Oman project

facts.claim: Trump's June 2025 financial disclosure listed licensing fees of $5 million and $15.8 million from Dar Al Arkan plus $1 million for a project in Oman; MPA Magazine reported the firm had paid more than $27 million since 2021 and was the single largest contributor to the Trump Organization's 2024 revenue.
facts.quote: the president listed two separate licensing fees, one for $5 million and another for $15.8 million, from a Saudi Arabia-based firm, Dar Al Arkan

facts.claim: The National reported that a 927-page disclosure filed in 2026 showed about $21.9 million in revenue from Dar Al Arkan for the prior year, about the same as the previous filing, plus a $5.25 million licence fee for a golf club and resort project in Doha.
facts.quote: included in the most recent filing is $5.25 million he received as a licence fee from a coming golf club and resort project in Doha
